## About Me

Ph.D. Scholar in **Electrical Engineering** at **Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay**, specializing in **Integrated Circuits and Systems (EE6)**. My research focuses on developing resource-efficient on-chip classifiers for neural applications, with emphasis on seizure detection and closed-loop neuromodulation.

## 📚 Current Research

### On-Chip Resource Efficient Classifiers for Neural Applications
*Ph.D. Thesis | Guide: Prof. Laxmeesha Somappa*

**Completed Work:**

- ✅ Designed **16-channel logistic regression-based on-chip Seizure Detector** with online retraining for adaptive closed-loop neuromodulation
- ✅ Developed **shared multiply-accumulate (MAC) architecture** reducing area and power while maintaining real-time throughput
- ✅ Completed full **RTL-to-GDSII flow** including synthesis, place-and-route, and sign-off

**Ongoing Work:**

- 🔄 Exploring **neural network architectures** for biomedical signal processing applications
- 🔄 Developing **hardware accelerators** for machine learning inference
- 🔄 Investigating **processor-accelerator integration** for flexible neural network deployment
- 🔄 Working on **ASIC design methodologies** for advanced technology nodes
